name: Catkissfish Integration for WooCommerce
author: catkissfish2021

sections.description:
CAT KISS FISH is a simple, user-friendly tool designed specifically for dropshipping merchants, helping you create unique, custom products with ease and efficiency.
With our assistance, you can quickly launch a print-on-demand dropshipping business.
As a brand, our mission is to continuously innovate—empowering everyone to freely express themselves in the global marketplace, and making design simple, intuitive, and accessible to all.
We are dedicated to helping every merchant achieve success. You can:
Choose from our curated selection of high-quality products to create and sell your own original designs.
Forget about the hassles of production, inventory management, packaging, and logistics;
We handle every step of the process for you.

How does CAT KISS FISH work?

  1. Sign up to create your CAT KISS FISH account.
  2. On the Plugins page, use the integration tool to connect your WooCommerce store by clicking “Install Now.”
  3. Activate the plugin via the WordPress “Plugins” menu.
  4. Click “Connect” to link your CAT KISS FISH account.
  5. Select a product and bring your creative vision to life through your design.
  6. List the product in your store and start selling.
    Once an order is placed, it automatically syncs with the CAT KISS FISH system; after you receive payment, we take full responsibility for handling all subsequent processes.

By choosing CAT KISS FISH, you gain access to:

  • A wide and diverse range of customizable products.
  • A free 3D design tool: Easy to use, providing realistic product previews.
  • End-to-end tracking for production, fulfillment, and delivery.
  • Automatic synchronization of product and order information.
  • A comprehensive catalog of custom-printed products across all categories.

Addition

  • This plugin was developed specifically to support CAT KISS FISH’s Print-on-Demand (POD) dropshipping services, enabling the seamless transmission and synchronization of product and order information between your store and CAT KISS FISH.
  • To ensure the delivery of stable and high-quality service, whenever products are added, edited, or deleted on the CAT KISS FISH platform, the relevant information is automatically synchronized to your store.
  • Conversely, when merchants add, edit, or delete products within their store, the corresponding information is simultaneously updated on the CAT KISS FISH platform, ensuring data consistency across both ends.
  • As a professional Print-on-Demand dropshipping platform, CAT KISS FISH assists merchants in fulfilling their orders.
  • Once an order is received by the merchant, the order details are automatically synchronized to CAT KISS FISH.
  • Throughout the fulfillment process—including production, shipping, and delivery—CAT KISS FISH provides real-time synchronization and updates regarding the status of each order.
    Learn more about our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘catkissfish-for-woocommerce’ to the’/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate the plugin after installing successfully
  3. Go to Catkissfish tab listed on the menu. Click the “Connect” button.
  4. Complete the authorization and connect the Catkissfish account.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Catkissfish account to use this plugin?

Yes. This plugin acts as a bridge between your WooCommerce store and the Catkissfish platform. You must have a registered account on catkissfish.com to design products and sync orders.

How do I connect my store to Catkissfish?

After activating the plugin, go to the “Catkissfish” tab in your WordPress admin menu and click the “Connect” button. You will be redirected to authorize the connection.

Are products automatically synchronized?

Yes. When you create or edit products on the Catkissfish platform, the information is automatically updated in your WooCommerce store.

Does the plugin support real-time order tracking?

Absolutely. The real-time status of production, shipping, and delivery will be automatically updated in your WooCommerce order details as we fulfill the order.

Is there a fee to use this plugin?

The plugin itself is free to install and use. You only pay for the product and shipping costs when an order is fulfilled by Catkissfish.
